summary: Full e2e test of AO-360 backend (26 pytest cases) and frontend Playwright flow. Backend 26/26 passing. Frontend: login+change-password flow, wrong-password generic error, period filter, Admin add-lending/add-recovery/target-incentive submit, Director approval, AO Pembiayaan dashboard (2 KPIs), Rekap, Insentif, Collection self-input, Leaderboard tabs (Pembiayaan/Funding/Recovery), Riwayat, Audit — all working. Success toasts render correctly.

issues: Default period is current real month (Sep 2026) which shows Rp 0 across the board because demo data is only seeded for 2026-01..2026-06. Consider defaulting the period picker to the newest available demo period, or add an empty-state hint pointing user to change period.

action_items: (optional/UX) Default period picker to latest period that has data (2026-06) instead of today so empty dashboards on first render don't confuse users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is fine because auth uses Bearer tokens in localStorage (not cookies). No auth cookie mismatch — acceptable per playbook (Bearer flow).
auth.py: 15-min lockout after 5 failed attempts is implemented correctly and reset on success.
incentive.py POST /incentives/target: computes nominal as realisasi * persen/100 — correct; correctly rejects achievement<100%.

collection.py get_photo: authorizes token via JWT decode only, does not verify the requesting user can access this specific photo/activity. Any authenticated user can fetch any collection photo by path. Minor privacy concern — consider scoping to owner/Admin/Direktur.

data_mgmt.py import_data: does not validate row schema per jenis; inserts arbitrary fields blindly. Potential data corruption vector for Admin uploads. Add per-jenis field whitelisting/pydantic model.
test_credentials: Login via kode_marketing + password 'BprsHM2026'; each account requires first-login change. Tests use 'NewPass2026' as changed password and reset back to pristine via /app/backend/tests/_reset_pw.py in a session-scoped autouse fixture.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* prefixed transactions (lending TEST-L-001/TEST-L-BOOST, funding TEST Funder B, recovery TEST-R-K4/TEST-R-WO, collection TEST-COL-01/TEST-ASSIGN-01, user T99) and UI-prefixed (UI-L-001, UI-R-001, UI-COL-01) during Playwright run. Not auto-cleaned; safe to leave in demo DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passwords are reset to pristine at session start/end by _reset_pw.py. If a manual run leaves accounts changed, run /root/.venv/bin/python /app/backend/tests/_reset_pw.py from /app/backend. Approval page uses tab values 'insentif' and 'user' (not 'incentives'/'user_requests'). Leaderboard uses tabs 'Pembiayaan'/'Funding'/'Recovery'. Period filter defaults to current real month — always set '2026-03' (or another 2026-01..06) in UI tests to see populated data.
